<svg width="1200" height="630" viewBox="0 0 1200 630" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <rect width="1200" height="630" fill="#0f172a"/>
  
  <circle id="logo-monogram" cx="160" cy="160" r="80" fill="#1e293b"/>
  <text x="160" y="188" font-family="DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="80" font-weight="bold"
        fill="#f59e0b" text-anchor="middle">D</text>
  <text x="280" y="150" font-family="DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="56" font-weight="bold" fill="#ffffff">Demo Fund</text>
  <text x="280" y="210" font-family="DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="32" fill="#94a3b8">Demo Riders</text>
  
  <clipPath id="bar-clip"><rect x="80" y="380" width="1040" height="40" rx="20"/></clipPath>
  <g clip-path="url(#bar-clip)">
    <rect id="bar-track" x="80" y="380" width="1040" height="40" fill="#1e293b"/>
    <rect id="bar-confirmed" x="80" y="380" width="468" height="40" fill="#f59e0b"/>
    <rect id="bar-pending" x="548" y="380" width="124.8" height="40" fill="#f59e0b" fill-opacity="0.4"/>
  </g>
  <text x="80" y="500" font-family="DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="44" font-weight="bold" fill="#ffffff">₱1,200 pending · ₱4,500 verified</text>
  <text x="80" y="556" font-family="DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="32" fill="#94a3b8">of ₱10,000 target</text>
  <text x="1120" y="590" font-family="DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="24" fill="#94a3b8" text-anchor="end">Motoclub Connect</text>
</svg>
